SPANISH: Hace cientos de años que en hermoso día apareció en el valle de Mexico un hombre blanco con cabello y barba negra...
LITERAL ENGLISH: Hundreds of years ago, on a beautiful day, a white man appeared in the Valley of Mexico with black hair and beard...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: Centuries ago, on a radiant day, a white man with black hair and beard appeared in the Valley of Mexico...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: Quetzalcoatl often appears in Mesoamerican myth as a light-skinned deity, later associated with wisdom and civilization.
TRANSLATION CLARIFICATION: Faithful translation emphasizes 'radiant day' and natural imagery.

SPANISH: Pronto se reunió a él un gran número de gente que crecía según el día avanzaba...
LITERAL ENGLISH: Soon a large number of people gathered around him as the day progressed...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: Soon, crowds gathered around him as the day advanced...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: The growing crowds reflect his role as a unifier and civilizer.
TRANSLATION CLARIFICATION: Smooths narrative to reflect growing societal importance.

SPANISH: Durante su permanencia allí hizo construir casas de oración y penitencia...
LITERAL ENGLISH: During his stay, he built houses of prayer and penance...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: During his time there, he built temples for prayer and reflection...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: Temples and penance reflect a move toward organized and moral religious practice.

SPANISH: Les predicaba la supresión de los sacrificios humanos...
LITERAL ENGLISH: He preached the abolition of human sacrifices...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: He taught against human sacrifices, promoting moral and simple worship...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: Human sacrifice was contested by Quetzalcoatl, seen as advocating a more ethical path.

SPANISH: Fue un rey sacerdote muy sabio; enseñó a muchos otros reyes a gobernar...
LITERAL ENGLISH: He was a very wise priest-king; he taught many other kings how to govern...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: He ruled wisely and taught kings to govern with prudence and justice...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: Quetzalcoatl as teacher and moral guide reflects priestly kingship ideals.
TRANSLATION CLARIFICATION: Faithful version stresses 'prudence and justice' as moral virtues.

SPANISH: Cambiaron sus costumbres, les enseñó artes, industrias...
LITERAL ENGLISH: Their customs changed, he taught them arts, industries...
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: He reformed customs, taught arts and industries, and introduced drinks from maguey and cacao...
CULTURAL CONTEXT: Reforming customs and arts symbolizes civilizational influence and cultural progress.
TRANSLATION CLARIFICATION: Adds detail for 'arts and industries' and cultural richness.

SPANISH: Pronto se confundió con el planeta Venus y se convirtió en el dios del viento.
LITERAL ENGLISH: Soon he merged with the planet Venus and became the god of the wind.
FAITHFUL ENGLISH: Eventually, he became associated with Venus and turned into the god of the wind.
CULTURAL CONTEXT: His association with Venus symbolizes cycles of renewal and cosmic importance.
TRANSLATION CLARIFICATION: Naturalizes 'merged' to 'became associated with' for cosmic metaphor.
